name: Skills and plugins
description: Copy a host folder's agent skills, plugins and subagents into a sandbox's workspace, links kept.

actions.label: Import skills and plugins
actions.description: Copies .agents/skills, .agents/plugins, .claude/skills, .claude/agents and .claude/commands from the host folder into the sandbox workspace. Memory, settings and other files stay on the host. Anything running in the sandbox can read the copies.

fields.label: Also copy its AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md
Replace files there that Asidee did not import
